target.statement: Ours (Full) achieves HMR 0.044 on the E.T. testset, outperforming E.T. (0.064) and DanceCam* (0.053).

compute.basis: The result depends on a two-stage 1B-parameter T2V/camera diffusion pipeline trained on 16 H800 GPUs using internal video/UE data, so reproducing it on an 8-core CPU laptop is not feasible.

blockers: No training code, weights, or configuration released
Base 1B T2V backbone is an internal research model not publicly available
Requires large internal datasets (400k unfiltered videos, 10k curated videos, 100k internal UE videos) plus MultiCamVideo/HumanVid UE data
E.T. testset refinement, GVHMR/UE pipeline, and baseline DanceCam* reimplementation details are incomplete
MLLM/user-study metrics use Gemini 2.5 Pro and human raters, not reproducible automatically
title: AdaViewPlanner: Adapting Video Diffusion Models for Viewpoint Planning in 4D Scenes
